name: Passage detail page hero and central question
description: The Passage (Passage of Time) assessment detail page shows the correct title, domain, duration, question count, tagline, and its central question in the top sections.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Passage assessment detail page
Verify the hero shows the heading 'The Passage of Time Assessment', the eyebrow 'Time & Temporality', a meta line with '~8 min' and '28 questions', and the tagline 'The arc of your time'.
Verify the 'What it measures' section shows the central question 'Where does your attention sit, and how do you feel about time passing?'.
